description: Update canonical character profile fields such as name, role, arc_summary, first_appearance, and traits. SQLite commits first, project backups refresh after commit, and the .meta.yaml file is refreshed only as generated compatibility output; prose notes are never modified.

character_id.description: The character_id to update (e.g. 'char-mira-nystrom'). Use list_characters to find valid IDs.

fields.description: Fields to update. Only supplied keys are changed.
